content: Hello, this is your life coaching support. How can I assist you today?
I'm feeling overwhelmed with the service I signed up for, and I'm not sure if I'm using it correctly.
I reassure you that feeling this way is completely normal at the start. You can trust me to help you navigate through this and gain confidence.
Thank you. I've tried following the instructions, but I keep getting stuck and it's discouraging.
Don't worry, many people experience similar challenges. Together, we'll break it down into manageable steps so you feel more comfortable.
That sounds helpful. What should I focus on first?
I suggest starting with the basics, and I'm here to support you every step of the way. You can trust me to guide you patiently.
